authority: Full 8,712-byte original EFZ PE identity from normal VC7.1 natural C++ source and independently reviewed relocation bindings
method: Single selected /Od /G6 /MT /Gy /W3 compile to normal COFF; strict complete-function comparison of all original PE bytes after materializing every independently attested COFF relocation target, no masking, ASM, patching, artificial padding or full cold replay
behavior: Result scene background layer, winning character rendering, two animated wraparound strip bands, overlay and menu choices, four score bonus readouts, high-order score digits and final video presentation
specific_native_findings: The first background frame references Context::extraA (+0xE98), not extraC (+0xEA0).
The original VC7.1 /Od renderer keeps one shared scroll-strip loop index across both seven-pass strip bands.
Parenthesized coordinates preserve original grouped 160/320 additions and subtraction order rather than folding equal constants into a different instruction sequence.
The positive high-score upper-word gate uses an unsigned greater-than-zero comparison, and integer-power division retains a separate native callee at 0x00775810.
